source.citation: Dugger et al. 2026, Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution 14:1868960

published_scale.handling: Do not use the inconsistent banded-total breakdown for quantitative estimability calculations unless Supplementary Table 1 or the raw banding inventory resolves the discrepancy after the outcome-access gate.
published_scale.typical_prospecting_context: Published discussion reports prospecting below 3% except Royds pre-breeders ages 5-7 prospecting at Bird, where estimates peak at 8-12%.
published_scale.moving_recruitment: Recruitment while moving to a new colony is reported as <0.10%, so prospecting and final settlement movement are distinct processes.

frozen_gate_scale.warning: These fractions are only broad scale comparisons. Ever-resighted birds are not equivalent to frozen eligible first-breeding events.

constraints_that_reduce_real_eligibility: Source gate counts only known-age first-breeding events satisfying the frozen state, temporal, performance, size and detection-availability rules.
Choice events additionally require PB observations in the two seasons preceding first breeding.
Candidate set must contain at least two actually visited Ross colonies and include the first breeding colony.
Prior-year three-colony performance must pass the >=20 interpretable breeder threshold.
Prior-year colony size must be complete for every candidate.
BIRD-containing candidate sets are excluded for first-breeding seasons 2014 onward.
MAPPPD size-control missing years and other frozen censoring rules can remove additional events.

decision.reason: The public study scale is large enough that 100 source events and 50 multi-candidate events are not obviously impossible, but published transition probabilities do not identify the number satisfying the much narrower frozen candidate-set and detection rules.
decision.if_source_gate_fails: STOP without fitting the choice model.
decision.if_source_gate_passes_but_choice_gate_fa: STOP without fitting the choice model.

claim_boundary: Do not use the internally inconsistent published banding breakdown to estimate an eligible recruitment count.
Do not infer prospective power or a probability of passing the gate from published transition-rate point estimates alone.
Do not relax the two-season lookback, candidate-set definition, detection controls, or 100/50 thresholds after real data are opened.
